finalText:
## On-Call Handoff — Gateway 503s

**Status at end of available data: ONGOING, not mitigated.**

### Root cause

Gateway config generation 119 flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. Each request now opens its own upstream connection instead of reusing a pooled one, so the 20-connection pool saturates instantly and all remaining requests queue until they time out as 503s.

```
02:13:41.234 INFO config  generation 119 applied: 3 keys changed
02:13:41.234 INFO config    gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true
02:13:41.234 INFO config    gateway.timeout.upstreamMs: 2000 -> 2500
```

Every 503 carries the same and only error code in the file:

```
ERROR access  req-07401 /v1/cart -> billing-svc 503 659ms
ERROR pool    req-07401 ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting 13)
```

Confirming signal at 03:02:30 — `WARN pool connection churn: 4180 opens in the last 5m, baseline is 40`, ~100x normal. Pool stays pinned at `in_use=20 idle=0` with the wait queue growing from 13 to 232.

The `upstreamMs` bump in the same change is unrelated to the failure — nothing times out against upstreams. Do not chase it.

### Impact window

| | |
|---|---|
| First 503 | **2026-03-14 02:14:18.972Z** (`req-07401`) |
| Last data point | 2026-03-14 03:59:27.974Z, still failing |
| Duration | **1h 45m and counting** |
| Failed requests | 530 in log, steady ~50 per 10 min (~5 of every 8) |
| Scope | All routes, all 4 upstreams, uniformly |
| Not affected | Workers — zero errors, pool flat at `in_use=1 idle=7` throughout |

Two things to flag for the postmortem:

- **`/health` returned 200 the entire time.** It falls in the ~1-in-8 slice that still gets a connection, so health checks never fired. On-call wasn't paged until **03:21:05** at 71% error rate — 67 minutes of user-visible failures with no alert.
- **No rollback has shipped.** Last deploy in the record is 03:25 (catalog-svc, unrelated).

### Roll back

**`dep-4471`** — gateway, a.novak, 2026-03-14 02:12–02:14, *"config: connection-per-request for pool isolation."*

Config-only change, so reverting `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false` (generation 119 → 118) should be sufficient and fast. Confirm recovery by watching for `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED` to stop and pool `idle` to climb off zero — don't trust `/health`, it was green throughout.

Ruled out: dep-4472 (billing-svc) started 02:41, 27 min *after* onset; dep-4473 (catalog-svc) 03:20, error rate unchanged across it; dep-4470 (worker) finished 01:48 with 80 min of clean traffic after.

### Do not roll back for this — separate issue

Worker job duration climbs steadily from 327ms to 2,197ms avg across the window (6.7x). It starts at 01:00, before the incident, and the slope is unchanged by every deploy boundary. `db_wait` stays ≤12ms, so it is not pool contention. Likely the unindexed scan already tracked as **OPS-2210** (`WARN db slow query 1.9s: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = ?`). Needs its own ticket; the gateway rollback will not help it.

---

Two caveats on the data: the gateway log header reads `node-3 of 3`, so this is one node — I'd assume the other two are in the same state but haven't confirmed it. And both logs stop at 03:59, so "ongoing" reflects the end of the file, not necessarily now.

Want this dropped into a file, or the other two gateway nodes checked if their logs are reachable?
